content:
catalog: ANALYTICS
schema: PUBLIC
table_name: ORDERS
description: One row per order
dimensions:
  id:
    primary_key: true
  customer_id: {}
  ordered_at:
    timeframes:
    - raw
    - date
    - week
    - month
    - quarter
    - year
  amount: {}
measures:
  revenue:
    sql: ${amount}
    aggregate_type: sum
    description: Total order revenue
  order_count:
    sql: ${id}
    aggregate_type: count_distinct

catalog: ANALYTICS
schema: PUBLIC
table_name: CUSTOMERS
description: Customer attributes
dimensions:
  id:
    primary_key: true
  name: {}
  segment: {}

- join_from_view: orders
  join_to_view: customers
  on_sql: ${orders.customer_id} = ${customers.id}
  relationship_type: many_to_one

base_view: orders
description: Orders and customer revenue
joins:
  customers: {}
